hypothesis: The r20 checkpoint's dominant generalization bottleneck is unseen medium structure rather than unseen source parameters within a known medium: complete-time layered and Marmousi relative L2 will remain at or below 0.10 for held-out sources from each anchor medium, while the next unseen medium groups may exceed 0.10.
expected_mechanism: The record-conditioned gate and source encoder should interpolate source position, frequency, and onset within a velocity field already encoded by the model. A new medium changes the entire spatial coefficient envelope and therefore demands reusable medium-to-field mapping rather than source interpolation alone.

single_conceptual_variable.name: generalization_axis
single_conceptual_variable.anchor: the exact layered and Marmousi records used to train r20
single_conceptual_variable.same_medium_new_source: all remaining train records sharing each anchor group_id
single_conceptual_variable.new_medium_new_source: all records in the next train group_id for each family
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: checkpoint, all model parameters, normalization, all 401 stored times, metric code and train split

primary_metric: complete 401-frame family relative L2 on the same-medium new-source panel
failure_signal: If either layered or Marmousi exceeds 0.10 on same-medium held-out sources, reject source interpolation and prioritize multiple sources per medium plus source-conditioning optimization. If same-medium passes but new-medium fails, prioritize medium diversity or a nonlocal medium mapper.

panels.uniform_exclusion_reason: Every train uniform group has exactly one record, so no same-medium held-out source exists.
panels.anchor_truth: train labels previously opened by r20
panels.same_medium_truth: train-only diagnostic, first successful metric opening in this run
panels.new_medium_truth: train-only diagnostic, first successful metric opening in this run

rollback: Do not train or open validation/test_id. Preserve r20 and use the diagnosed axis to choose one subsequent data or algorithm variable.
